verdict.rationale: Flagright documents alert retrieval (GET /management/alerts/{alertId}), alert-hit status filters, and user rule-execution results. None of the evidence describes showing what changed, such as a diff, change history, or triggering-delta view, for a monitored customer when a new alert fires. Fetching an alert or user payload is an adjacent feature, not the story's change-inspection capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can inspect what changed when a monitored customer produces a new alert
